bound_user_triggers.name: profiles_kerndaten_aus_auth
bound_user_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER profiles_kerndaten_aus_auth AFTER INSERT ON profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION profil_kerndaten_aus_auth()
bound_user_triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.profil_kerndaten_aus_auth()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.profiles p
  set
    email = coalesce(u.email, p.email),
    display_name = coalesce(
      p.display_name,
      (u.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name'),
      (u.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name'),
      split_part(u.email, '@', 1)
    )
  from auth.users u
  where p.user_id = new.user_id and u.id = new.user_id;
  return new;
end
$function$

profile_predicates.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aktuelle_rolle()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

  select p.role

profile_predicates.definition:

profile_predicates.name: darf_konten_verwalten
profile_predicates.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.darf_konten_verwalten()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select public.hat_rolle_mindestens('moderator')
     and public.aktuelles_admin_aal2()
$function$

profile_predicates.name: hat_rolle_mindestens
profile_predicates.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hat_rolle_mindestens(minimum text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
           public.rollenrang(public.aktuelle_rolle()) >= public.rollenrang(minimum),
           false)
$function$

profile_predicates.name: rollenrang
profile_predicates.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rollenrang(rolle text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case rolle
           when 'user'      then 0
           when 'creator'   then 10
           when 'moderator' then 20
           when 'operator'  then 30
           when 'admin'     then 40
           when 'owner'     then 50
         end
$function$

fixtureDistinctions.numericOids: Actual Dev numeric OIDs are retained in evidence only; fixture and installer resolve real local relationships.
fixtureDistinctions.uuidDefault: Receipt records only uuid_generate_v4() expression; its schema, implementation and extension membership were not observed. Native uses an explicitly synthetic public.uuid_generate_v4 -> pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid adapter solely to reproduce this name/default.
fixtureDistinctions.authHelpers: Native uses unchanged E09 auth.uid/auth.jwt body pins already preserved by accepted PG1. All users, sessions and claims in Native are synthetic.
fixtureDistinctions.additionalShapeGates: Installer additionally refuses inheritance and incoming postgres-role membership; these are gates, not newly claimed observations.
fixtureDistinctions.indexCoverage: Existing profile index/catalog rows are captured and preserved during apply, without claiming an earlier full index-definition observation.
